adrenaline.name: Adrenaline

alert-trip-mine.name: Alert Trip Mines

ambidextrous.name: Ambidextrous

assailant.name: Assailant

auto-4-shorty.name: Auto-4 Shorty

baseball-bat.name: Baseball Bat
baseball-bat.description: Wooden Baseball Bat that swings fast and powerfully.

bear-traps.name: Bear Traps

beastface.name: Beastface

Reduce reaction range of animals (doesn't affect Monsters like Hellhounds ).

berserker.name: Berserker

berthier-1892.name: Berthier 1892

berthier-1892-deadeye.name: Berthier 1892 Deadeye

berthier-1892-marksman.name: Berthier 1892 Marksman

berthier-1892-riposte.name: Berthier 1892 Riposte
berthier-1892-riposte.description: French made, bolt-action carbine. High power for its light barrel. Partial reloads are punishing. Modified with a long bladed saber.

big-dynamite-bundle.name: Big Dynamite Bundle
big-dynamite-bundle.description: A bundle of seven dynamite sticks, for when something really needs to be blown up.

blade-seer.name: Blade Seer
blade-seer.description: While using Dark Sight, increases distance of highlighted Bolts, Arrows, Harpoon, Throwing Axes, and Throwing Knives to 75m. Also applies to Beetle View.

blank-fire-decoys.name: Blank Fire Decoys
blank-fire-decoys.description: A decoy that imitates the sound of a gunshot on impact. Useful to distract and confuse enemies. Comes in a pack of six.

blast-sense.name: Blast Sense
blast-sense.description: Loud sounds such as gunshots and explosions are highlighted while in Dark Sight. Gunshots from Silenced Weapons with Subsonic Ammo cannot be seen. (200m)

bloodless.name: Bloodless
bloodless.description: Bleeding will not escalate from lignt to medium or intense bleeding.

bolt-thrower.name: Bolt Thrower
bolt-thrower.description: Reduced reload time for Crossbows, Bomb Launchers, and Bomb Lances.

bomb-lance.name: Bomb Lance
bomb-lance.description: Bladed harpoon launcher, adapted to fire projectiles with a delayed explosive. Lethal at short range but cumbersome to reload.

bomb-launcher.name: Bomb Launcher
bomb-launcher.description: This compact launcher fires spring-loaded projectiles over short distances. Deals tremendous damage on direct impact.

bornheim-no-3.name: Bornheim No. 3
bornheim-no-3.description: German made, semi-automatic pistol. High fire-rate and velocity, and low recoil. Balanced by low power and wasteful reloads. Can be dual wielded.

bornheim-no-3-extended.name: Bornheim No. 3 Extended

bornheim-no-3-match.name: Bornheim No. 3 Match

bornheim-no-3-silencer.name: Bornheim No. 3 Silencer
bornheim-no-3-silencer.description: German made, semi-automatic pistol. High fire-rate and velocity, and low recoil. Balanced by low power and wasteful reloads. Modified with a silencer. Can be dual wielded.

bulletgrubber.name: Bulletgrubber
bulletgrubber.description: Recover unfired round when performing partial reloads.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.description: Reduce the damage from explosions by 50%. Vastly reduces the duration of being fully blinded by a Flash Bomb.

caldwell-conversion-pistol.name: Conversion
caldwell-conversion-pistol.description: Caldwell made, single-action revolver. Slow to reload, but reliable and accurate. Converted to fire cartridges. Can be dual wielded.

caldwell-conversion-uppercut.name: Uppercut
caldwell-conversion-uppercut.description: Caldwell made, single-action revolver. Based on the Conversion, this fires Long Ammo for more damage, but kicks like a mule. Can be dual wielded.

caldwell-pax.name: Pax
caldwell-pax.description: Caldwell made, single-action revolver. Reliable, accurate, and sturdy. Once brought peace to the lawless west. Can be dual wielded.

caldwell-rival-78.name: Rival 78
caldwell-rival-78.description: Caldwell made, break-action shotgun with two barrels. High damage but high pellet spread, two-tapping gives it an edge.

catalyst.name: Catalyst
catalyst.description: Unlock Conditional Trait Effects on the Beastface, Kiteskin, Vigilant, Pain Sense, and Frontiersman Traits. Conditional Effects activate when their base Trait is equipped.

cavalry-saber.name: Cavalry Saber
cavalry-saber.description: One-handed saber in use since the Civil War. Lightweight with good reach.

centennial-pointman.name: Centennial Pointman
centennial-pointman.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High muzzle velocity and good damage at range. Shortened stock and modified with a mid-to-long-range scope.

centennial-shorty.name: Centennial Shorty
centennial-shorty.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High muzzle velocity and good damage at range. Shortened stock and barrel.

centennial-shorty-silencer.name: Centennial Shorty Silencer
centennial-shorty-silencer.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High muzzle velocity and good damage at range. Shortened and modified with a silencer.

centennial-sniper.name: Centennial Sniper
centennial-sniper.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High muzzle velocity and good damage at range. Modified with a long-range scope.

centennial-trauma.name: Centennial Trauma
centennial-trauma.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High muzzle velocity and good damage at range. Modified with a stock mounted bludgeon.

chaos-bomb.name: Chaos Bomb
chaos-bomb.description: Set of firecrackers that can be used to temporarily distract nearby enemies. Duration of about 30 seconds.

choke-beetle.name: Choke Beetle
choke-beetle.description: Choke Beetles are bred to find and track prey, giving Hunters a view from above. They have also evolved to explode into a cloud of suffocating gas, which they themselves are immune to.

choke-bombs.name: Choke Bombs
choke-bombs.description: The Choke Bomb exudes a gas that extinguishes any flames within its radius while active–as well as preventing new fires form being lit–and induces heavy coughing. Comes in a pack of two.

chu-ko-nu.name: Chu Ko Nu
chu-ko-nu.description: Repeating Crossbow that fires Compact Bolts. Has a high rate of fire and is quiet. Bolts can be recovered and reused.

combat-axe.name: Combat Axe
combat-axe.description: Two-handed axe that swings slowly but splits skulls.

concertina-bomb.name: Concertina Bomb
concertina-bomb.description: Spring-loaded razorwire coil that unfolded violently when thrown. Shreds and entangles anything that tries to move through.

concertina-trip-mine.name: Concertina Trip Mines
concertina-trip-mine.description: This portable tripwire mine deploys a small concertina bundle perfect for blocking doors and windows. Comes in a pack of two.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.description:
Get a Health and Stamina boost when your team picks up a Clue or closes a Rift.
SOLO: Doubles the effects of investigating a Clue.

conversion-chain-pistol.name: Conversion Chain Pistol
conversion-chain-pistol.description: Caldwell made, single-action revolver. Slow to reload, but reliable and accurate. Converted to fire cartridges. Modified with an extended chain cylinder. Can be dual wielded.

crossbow.name: Crossbow

crossbow-deadeye.name: Crossbow Deadeye

crown-king-auto-5.name: Auto-5
crown-king-auto-5.description: Crown & King made, semi-automatic shotgun. Dominates close range with high power and fire-rate, but has a strong recoil.

dark-dynamite-satchel.name: Dark Dynamite Satchel
dark-dynamite-satchel.description: A deployable bundle of dynamite sticks that are detonated remotely via Dark Sight. Can be attached to walls and floors.

dauntless.name: Dauntless
dauntless.description: Thrown explosives can be defused when interacting with them.

death-cheat.name: Death Cheat
death-cheat.description: You will not lose your Hunter if you fail to extract, but equipment and missing Health Chunks will be lost.

decoy-fuses.name: Decoy Fuses
decoy-fuses.description: Pack of Decoy Fuses that can be used to breach closed doors and window shutters. It can also imitate the behavior of a lit bomb and can fool your enemies into clearing a space. Comes in a pack of three.

decoy-supply.name: Decoy Supply
decoy-supply.description: Restock all types of Decoys from Ammo Crates.

decoys.name: Decoys
decoys.description: A bag of scrap metal and glass. When thrown the noise can be effectively used to distract or divert enemies. Comes in a pack of twelve.

derringer-pennyshot.name: Derringer Pennyshot
derringer-pennyshot.description: A small, light pistol tool that holds two Penny Shot Ammo rounds. Perfect in a pinch.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.description: Doubles the amount of Health restored by First Aid Kit.

dolch-96.name: Dolch 96
dolch-96.description: Ludwig Arms made, semi-automatic pistol. High power and fire-rate. When empty, can be reloaded with a stripper clip. Can be dual wielded.

drilling-shorty.name: Drilling Shorty
drilling-shorty.description: German made, break-action combination firearm with two rifle barrels and single shotgun underbarrel. Highly flexible. Shortened stock and barrel.

dusters.name: Dusters
dusters.description: Brass knuckles worn on the hand for blunt and brutal punches.

dynamite-bundle.name: Dynamite Bundle
dynamite-bundle.description: A bundle of several dynamite sticks. Why only bring one?

dynamite-stick.name: Dynamite Stick
dynamite-stick.description: A dynamite stick that detonates with a massive blast after four seconds.

fanning.name: Fanning
fanning.description: Faster rate of fire when using one-handed or two-handed single-action pistols.

fast-fingers.name: Fast Fingers

fire-beetle.name: Fire Beetle

fire-bomb.name: Fire Bomb
fire-bomb.description: Flammable liquid in a glass container that bursts on impact. Spreads burning liquid over a large area

first-aid-kit.name: First Aid Kit
first-aid-kit.description: A bag of medical supplies that heal 50 health and stop bleeding. Can be used three times.

flame-rifle.name: Flame Rifle
flame-rifle.description: Custom-made, rifle conversion that releases pressurized liquid which ignites on ejection, producing a steady burst of flames. Requires pumping to increase pressure - higher pressure means longer reaching flames. The pressure is lost over time and while shooting. Can only resupply at Oil Barrels.

flare-pistol.name: Flare Pistol
flare-pistol.description: A small pistol for firing flares into the air, illuminating the area. Can ignite flammable materials.

flash-bomb.name: Flash Bomb

frag-bomb.name: Frag Bomb
frag-bomb.description: Frag bombs send lethal shrapnel over a large area, lacerating nearby enemies. However, unlike Dynamite, the blast is not strong enough to destroy doors or concertina wire.

frontier-73c.name: Frontier 73C
frontier-73c.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. A lightened Ranger 73, this trades convenience for a slightly reduced capacity.

frontier-73c-marksman.name: Frontier 73C Marksman
frontier-73c-marksman.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. A lightened Ranger 73, this trades convenience for a slightly reduced capacity. Modified with a mid-to-long-range scope.

frontier-73c-silencer.name: Frontier 73C Silencer
frontier-73c-silencer.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. A lightened Ranger 73, this trades convenience for a slightly reduced capacity. Modified with a silencer.

frontiersman.name: Frontiersman
frontiersman.description:
Use Tools one extra time.

fusees.name: Fusees

gator-legs.name: Gator Legs

ghoul.name: Ghoul

greyhound.name: Greyhound

hellfire-bomb.name: Hellfire Bomb

hive-bomb.name: Hive Bomb

homestead-78.name: Homestead 78

kiteskin.name: Kiteskin

nagant-m1895-precision.description: Nagant made, single-action revolver. Medium damage, with a decent muzzle velocity and capacity. Modified with an added stock.

nagant-m1895-silencer.name: Nagant M1895 Silencer
nagant-m1895-silencer.description: Nagant made, single-action revolver. Medium damage, with a decent muzzle velocity and capacity. Modified with a silencer. Can be dual wielded.

nagant-officer-carbine.name: Officer Carbine
nagant-officer-carbine.description: Nagant made, double-action revolver. High fire-rate, muzzle velocity, and capacity at the cost of damage and reload speed. Extended stock and barrel.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.description:
Using Dark Sight, revive a downed teammate from a distance. (25m)
SOLO: You can revive your downed Hunter. Triggers a Full Health Restoration upon revive.

new-army.name: New Army
new-army.description: Caldwell made, double-action revolver. High cycle rate and good damage, but balanced by low muzzle velocity. Can be dual wielded.

new-army-swift.name: New Army Swift
new-army-swift.description: Caldwell made, double-action revolver. High cycle rate and good damage, but balanced by low muzzle velocity. Uses a speed-loader for faster reloading. Can be dual wielded.

nitro-express.name: Nitro Express
nitro-express.description: American made, break-action rifle with two barrels. High power, but limited ammunition, and damage drops over range.

officer.name: Officer
officer.description: Nagant made, double-action revolver. High fire-rate, muzzle velocity, and capacity at the cost of damage and reload speed. Can be dual wielded.

officer-brawler.name: Officer Brawler
officer-brawler.description: Nagant made, double-action revolver. High fire-rate, muzzle velocity, and capacity at the cost of damage and reload speed. Modified with brass knuckles for melee. Can be dual wielded.

officer-carbine-deadeye.name: Officer Carbine Deadeye
officer-carbine-deadeye.description: Nagant made, double-action revolver. High fire-rate, muzzle velocity, and capacity at the cost of damage and reload speed. Extended stock and barrel, modified with a Deadeye scope.

packmule.name: Packmule
packmule.description: Receive an additional item when looting Hunters or opening Tool Boxes.

pain-sense.name: Pain Sense
pain-sense.description:
You can see nearby bleeding, poisoned and burning Hunters while in Dark Sight. Also applies to Beetle view. (150m)
CATALYST: Includes Hunters out of Stamina.

pax-claw.name: Pax Claw
pax-claw.description: Caldwell made, single-action revolver. Reliable, accurate, and sturdy. Once brought peace to the lawless west. Modified with a grip-mounted blade. Can be dual wielded.

pax-trueshot.name: Pax Trueshot
pax-trueshot.description: Caldwell made, single-action revolver. Reliable, accurate, and sturdy. Once brought peace to the lawless west. Modified with an extended barrel. Can be dual wielded.

physician.name: Physician
physician.description: Reduce the time needed to bandage.

pitcher.name: Pitcher
pitcher.description: Increased throwing range for all items using the aim helper.

poison-bomb.name: Poison Bomb
poison-bomb.description: On detonation emits a persistent, deadly cloud. Anything that passes through or gets caught in the cloud will be poisoned.

poison-trip-mine.name: Poison Trip Mines
poison-trip-mine.description: This portable tripwire mine released a cloud of poison when triggered, disorienting enemies. Comes in a pack of two.

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
poltergeist.description: While using Dark Sight, remotely manipulate, interact with, and agitate in-world objects and animals. (50m) Also applies to Beetle View.

quad-derringer.name: Quad Derringer
quad-derringer.description: A small, light pistol that is easy to carry and conceal. Holds four shots. Twelve additional rounds carried.

railroad-hammer.name: Railroad Hammer
railroad-hammer.description: Two-handed Hammer, swings with weight and power.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.description: Killing an enemy Hunter while at least one Health Chunk is empty triggers a Restoration for your Hunter.

ranger-73-aperture.name: Ranger 73 Aperture
ranger-73-aperture.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High fire-rate, large magazine, easy reload, and good handling. Modified with an enhanced toggle-able sight.

ranger-73-swift.name: Ranger 73 Swift
ranger-73-swift.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High fire-rate, large magazine, easy reload, and good handling. Uses a speed-loader for faster reloading.

ranger-73-talon.name: Ranger 73 Talon
ranger-73-talon.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High fire-rate, large magazine, easy reload, and good handling. Modified with a stock-mounted blade.

recovery-shot.name: Recovery Shot
recovery-shot.description: A shot that restores a lost Health Chunk.

regeneration-shot.name: Regeneration Shot
regeneration-shot.description: A shot that continually restores health over a long duration.

regeneration-shot-weak.name: Regeneration Shot (Weak)
regeneration-shot-weak.description: A shot that continually restores health over a short duration.

relentless.name: Relentless
relentless.description: Your Hunter won't lose a Health Chunk when downed.

remedy.name: Remedy
remedy.description: While using Dark Sight, interact with a Trait Spur within range to trigger a Restoration effect for your team. (25m) Also applies to Beetle view.

resilience.name: Resilience
resilience.description: Your Hunter is revived with up to full health.

rival-78-mace.name: Rival 78 Mace
rival-78-mace.description: Caldwell made, break-action shotgun with two barrels. High damage but high pellet spread, two-tapping gives it an edge. Shortened and modified with a rear bludgeon.

rival-78-shorty.name: Rival 78 Shorty
rival-78-shorty.description: Caldwell made, break-action shotgun with two barrels. High damage but high pellet spread, two-tapping gives it an edge. Shortened stock and barrel.

rival-78-trauma.name: Rival 78 Trauma
rival-78-trauma.description: Caldwell made, break-action shotgun with two barrels. High damage but high pellet spread, two-tapping gives it an edge. Modified with a stock-mounted bludgeon.

romero-77.name: Romero 77
romero-77.description: American made, break-action shotgun with single barrel. High damage, cost-effective, and tight bullet spread.

romero-77-alamo.name: Romero 77 Alamo
romero-77-alamo.description: American made, break-action shotgun with single barrel. High damage, cost-effective, and tight bullet spread. Modified with an added magazine and loader.

romero-77-hatchet.name: Romero 77 Hatchet
romero-77-hatchet.description: American made, break-action shotgun with single barrel. High damage, cost-effective, and tight bullet spread. Shortened and modified with an axe blade.

romero-77-shorty.name: Romero 77 Shorty
romero-77-shorty.description: American made, break-action shotgun with single barrel. High damage, cost-effective, and tight bullet spread. Shortened stock and barrel.

romero-77-talon.name: Romero 77 Talon
romero-77-talon.description: American made, break-action shotgun with single barrel. High damage, cost-effective, and tight bullet spread. Modified with a stock-mounted blade.

salveskin.name: Salveskin
salveskin.description: While alive, reduce all fire damage and stop burn speed and stop time from escalating.

scopesmith.name: Scopesmith
scopesmith.description: Remain in scope view after firing a shot while using any weapon with a scope.

scottfield-brawler.name: Scottfield Brawler
scottfield-brawler.description: Scottfield made, single-action top-break revolver. Performs well at medium range and can be reloaded quickly when empty. Modified with brass knuckles for melee. Can be dual wielded.

scottfield-model-3.name: Scottfield
scottfield-model-3.description: Scottfield made, single-action top-break revolver. Performs well at medium range and can be reloaded quickly when empty. Can be dual wielded.

scottfield-precision.name: Scottfield Precision
scottfield-precision.description: Scottfield made, single-action top-break revolver. Performs well at medium range and can be reloaded quickly when empty. Modified with an added stock.

scottfield-spitfire.name: Scottfield Spitfire
scottfield-spitfire.description: Scottfield made, single-action top-break revolver. Performs well at medium range and can be reloaded quickly when empty. Shortened barrel and modified trigger for higher rate of fire. Can be dual wielded.

scottfield-swift.name: Scottfield Swift
scottfield-swift.description: Scottfield made, single-action top-break revolver. Performs well at medium range and can be reloaded quickly when empty. Uses a speed-loader for faster reloading. Can be dual wielded.

serpent.name: Serpent
serpent.description:
Using Dark Sight, interact with nearby Clues, Rifts, banishable Targets and abandoned Bounty Tokens. (25m) Applies to Beetle View, except for Bounty Token interactions.
SOLO: Interaction range increased. (50m)

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.description: Monsters can't see and won't attack you, but they can still hear you.

shadow-leap.name: Shadow Leap
shadow-leap.description: Using Dark Sight, channel a Monster within range to jump to its location and kill it instantly. Excludes Targets. (50m)

shredder.name: Shredder
shredder.description: Experimental weapon that shoots sawblades. Sawblades bounce off hard surfaces and rip into targets. Runes etchings give them the potential to ricochet in the direction of nearby enemies. Must be spun before firing. Only found at the circus.

silent-killer.name: Silent Killer
silent-killer.description: Reduce noise when performing melee attacks.

slate.name: Slate
slate.description: Winfield made, pump-action shotgun. High damage and fast cycle rate, with high pellet spread.

slate-riposte.name: Slate Riposte
slate-riposte.description: Winfield made, pump-action shotgun. High damage and fast cycle rate, with high pellet spread. Modified with a long bladed saber.

sparks-lrr.name: Sparks
sparks-lrr.description: Big-game, single-shot rifle. High power and very effective at range, but cumbersome. Can put down a bison across a prairie.

sparks-pistol.name: Sparks Pistol
sparks-pistol.description: Single-shot rifle, cut down into a small handgun. Equally powerful up to mid-range, and convenient to handle. Increased recoil. Can be dual wielded.

sparks-pistol-silencer.name: Sparks Pistol Silencer
sparks-pistol-silencer.description: Single-shot rifle, cut down into a small handgun. Equally powerful up to mid-range, and convenient to handle. Increased recoil. Modified with a silencer. Can be dual wielded.

sparks-silencer.name: Sparks Silencer
sparks-silencer.description: Big-game, single-shot rifle. High power and very effective at range, but cumbersome. Can put down a bison across a prairie. Modified with a silencer.

sparks-sniper.name: Sparks Sniper
sparks-sniper.description: Big-game, single-shot rifle. High power and very effective at range, but cumbersome. Can put down a bison across a prairie. Modified with a long-range scope.

specter-1882.name: Specter 1882
specter-1882.description: Specter made, pump-action shotgun. Tight pellet spread and competitive rate of fire, but wasteful reloads.

specter-1882-bayonet.name: Specter 1882 Bayonet
specter-1882-bayonet.description: Specter made, pump-action shotgun. Tight pellet spread and competitive rate of fire, but wasteful reloads. Modified with a bayonet for melee.

specter-1882-shorty.name: Specter 1882 Shorty
specter-1882-shorty.description: Specter made, pump-action shotgun. Tight pellet spread and competitive rate of fire, but wasteful reloads. Shortened stock and barrel.

springfield-1866.name: Springfield 1866
springfield-1866.description: Springfield made, breech-loading trapdoor rifle. Fires single shots and is effective at long range.

springfield-1866-bayonet.name: Springfield 1866 Bayonet
springfield-1866-bayonet.description: Springfield made, breech-loading trapdoor rifle. Fires single shots and is effective at long range. Modified with a bayonet for melee.

springfield-1866-bullseye.name: Springfield 1866 Bullseye
springfield-1866-bullseye.description: Springfield made, breech-loading trapdoor rifle. Fires single shots and is effective at long range. Modified with a Deadeye scope, but no stock.

springfield-1866-marksman.name: Springfield 1866 Marksman
springfield-1866-marksman.description: Springfield made, breech-loading trapdoor rifle. Fires single shots and is effective at long range. Modified with a mid-to-long-range scope.

springfield-1866-shorty.name: Springfield 1866 Shorty
springfield-1866-shorty.description: Springfield made, breech-loading trapdoor rifle. Fires single shots and is effective at long range. Shortened stock and barrel.

springfield-1866-striker.name: Springfield 1866 Striker
springfield-1866-striker.description: Springfield made, breech-loading trapdoor rifle. Fires single shots and is effective at long range. Shortened and modified with a bayonet.

spyglass.name: Spyglass
spyglass.description: A monocular optical instrument for seeing things far away as if they were nearby

stalker-beetle.name: Stalker Beetle
stalker-beetle.description: Stalker Beetles are bred to find and track prey, giving Hunters a view from above. As a last resort, they can sacrifice themselves to cause a small explosion, hampering anything caught in the radius.

stamina-shot.name: Stamina Shot
stamina-shot.description: A shot which immediately restores all stamina and stops further depletion for a long duration.

stamina-shot-weak.name: Stamina Shot (Weak)
stamina-shot-weak.description: A shot which immediately restores all stamina and stops further depletion for a short duration..

steady-aim.name: Steady Aim
steady-aim.description: Gradually lessen weapon sway when looking through a scope or Aperture sights.

sticky-bomb.name: Sticky Bomb
sticky-bomb.description: Dynamite charge in a sticky frame that can be attached to objects and enemies. Its eight-second fuse doubles the detonation time of a dynamite stick.

surefoot.name: Surefoot
surefoot.description: You can sprint while holding primed Throwables, First Aid Kits, and Consumable Shots.

terminus.name: Terminus
terminus.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating shotgun. High capacity and damage, but wasteful reloads.

terminus-shorty.name: Terminus Shorty
terminus-shorty.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating shotgun. High capacity and damage, but wasteful reloads. Shortened stock and barrel.

throwing-axes.name: Throwing Axes
throwing-axes.description: Silent and deadly short-ranged projectile weapon. Can be retrieved and reused. Comes in a pack of two.

throwing-knives.name: Throwing Knives
throwing-knives.description: Silent, but short-ranged projectile weapon. Thrown knives can be retrieved and reused. Comes in a pack of eight.

throwing-spear.name: Throwing Spear
throwing-spear.description: Two-handed melee weapon, also balanced for throwing straight and true. Can be retrieved and reused. You'll receive one, be careful how you use it.

tool-box.name: Tool Box
tool-box.description: A portable toolkit that refills some dwindling supplies in a tight spot.

uppercut-deadeye.name: Uppercut Deadeye
uppercut-deadeye.description: Caldwell made, single-action revolver. Based on the Conversion, this fires Long Ammo for more damage, but kicks like a mule. Modified with a Deadeye scope and stock.

uppercut-precision.name: Uppercut Precision
uppercut-precision.description: Caldwell made, single-action revolver. Based on the Conversion, this fires Long Ammo for more damage, but kicks like a mule. Modified with an added stock.

vandal-73c.name: Vandal 73C
vandal-73c.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. A shortened Frontier 73C, this has a reduced capacity and range, but is handier.

vandal-73c-bullseye.name: Vandal 73C Bullseye
vandal-73c-bullseye.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. A shortened Frontier 73C, this has a reduced capacity and range, but is handier. Modified with a Deadeye scope, but no stock.

vandal-73c-striker.name: Vandal 73C Striker
vandal-73c-striker.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. A shortened Frontier 73C, this has a reduced capacity and range, but is handier. Shortened and modified with a bayonet.

vetterli-71-bayonet.name: Vetterli 71 Bayonet
vetterli-71-bayonet.description: Swiss made, bolt-action carbine. Powerful at medium distances, and easy to reload. Balances ease of use with damage. Modified with a bayonet for melee.

vetterli-71-cyclone.name: Vetterli 71 Cyclone
vetterli-71-cyclone.description: Swiss made, bolt-action carbine. Powerful at medium distances, and easy to reload. Balances ease of use with damage. Modified with a semi-automatic conversion.

vetterli-71-deadeye.name: Vetterli 71 Deadeye
vetterli-71-deadeye.description: Swiss made, bolt-action carbine. Powerful at medium distances, and easy to reload. Balances ease of use with damage. Modified with a mid-range scope.

vetterli-71-karabiner.name: Vetterli 71
vetterli-71-karabiner.description: Swiss made, bolt-action carbine. Powerful at medium distances, and easy to reload. Balances ease of use with damage.

vetterli-71-marksman.name: Vetterli 71 Marksman
vetterli-71-marksman.description: Swiss made, bolt-action carbine. Powerful at medium distances, and easy to reload. Balances ease of use with damage. Modified with a mid-to-long-range scope.

vetterli-71-silencer.name: Vetterli 71 Silencer
vetterli-71-silencer.description: Swiss made, bolt-action carbine. Powerful at medium distances, and easy to reload. Balances ease of use with damage. Modified with a silencer.

vigilant.name: Vigilant
vigilant.description:
While using Dark Sight, nearby Traps and active Beetles are highlighted. Also applies to Beetle View. (25m)
CATALYST: Double the highlighted range in Dark Sight.

vigor.name: Vigor
vigor.description: While in Dark Sight, doubles the rate at which Health and Stamina regenerate.

vitality-shot.name: Vitality Shot
vitality-shot.description: A shot which immediately restores all health.

vitality-shot-weak.name: Vitality Shot (Weak)
vitality-shot-weak.description: A shot which immediately restores 75 health.

vulture.name: Vulture
vulture.description: Looting a Hunter will always reward you money.

waxed-dynamite-stick.name: Waxed Dynamite Stick
waxed-dynamite-stick.description: A dynamite stick with a modified powder fuse that enables detonation under water and in choke bomb clouds.

wildland.name: Wildland
wildland.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. Based on the Centennial, it features a long barrel and Swift reloader.

winfield-1876-centennial.name: Centennial
winfield-1876-centennial.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High muzzle velocity and good damage at range.

winfield-m1873.name: Ranger 73
winfield-m1873.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High fire-rate, large magazine, easy reload, and good handling.

witness.name: Witness
witness.description: While using Dark Sight, dead Hunters and Monsters are visible. Also applies to Beetle View.
